messages:
Aisha: Quick quirky holiday plan idea  tiny socks swap? We each mail a pair of silly socks to one person, include a short kudos note, and reveal receipts at the holiday breakfast. Low effort, high joy. :socks:
Marco: Im so into this. Logistics q: anonymous or reveal upfront?
Aisha: I vote anonymous for the surprise. Also optional: add one line wishing someone on the team something specific (keeps the kudos personal).
Deena: Count me in. Also can we do a tiny virtual background contest during the breakfast? Best background gets the office cookie crown.
Liam: Love the combo. Socks + backgrounds + kudos. I will volunteer to collect addresses in a private DM and handle the random draw.
HRBot: Reminder: When sharing addresses, use direct messages only. Do not post personal contact info publicly. :lock:
Marco: Question about mailing budgets  how fancy can folks go? I propose $10-15 per pair so it's fair.
Aisha: Budget sounds good. If anyone wants to be extra thrifty, handknit socks are allowed but please put care instructions. :yarn:
Deena: Kudo for @Marco right now for always bringing the snacks to retro. Small things = big morale.
Marco: Thanks! Kudo to @Deena for the onboarding notes  saved me half a headache this month.
Liam: Meme: "When you try to prod the model into holiday cheer and it returns your shopping list" + tiny GIF :joy:
PantryPolly: Pantry update: holiday granola jars arriving at 1pm tomorrow. Please label allergen-free boxes. :package:
Aisha: Plan: DM me your postal address by next Wed, I'll run the randomizer and post pairings in a separate (non-public) message. Drop a one-liner kudos in the swap note. We'll aim to ship by Dec 18 so things arrive before the office party.
Marco: Virtual background contest theme suggestions: 'Cozy infra', 'Winter bugs', 'Model sleighs'  I vote Cozy infra.
Deena: Ill make a goofy background: a tiny server covered in fairy lights. Also tiny kudos to @Liam for helping with the flaky deploy last week.
Liam: Appreciated. Kudo incoming to @Aisha for the team morale initiatives this year. You're the cheer captain.
Aisha: Aw thanks y'all. Also if anyone needs help getting socks mailed from outside the country, ping me and I'll coordinate sample shipping days.
HRBot: FYI: If you are remote-international and opt into swap, reimbursements for postage up to $20 available. Please file expense with category "holiday swap".
Marco: Spinning pairings now  will DM. (I am not responsible if you get socks in your size and you hate stripes)
PantryPolly: Quick safety note: if sending edible gifts with socks, please annotate ingredients. Non-food gifts preferred. :memo:
Deena: Done pairing! (DMs sent). Also reminder: background contest voting will be live during the breakfast. Post your background and we'll react to vote.
Liam: :snowflake: on @Deena for the onboarding help, :snowflake: on @Marco for running logistics
Aisha: Final note: anyone wants to include a tiny hand-written holiday greeting, I'll collect them and print small tags. Makes socks feel extra special.
Marco: This is turning into the cutest operation. Happy almost-holidays, team :tada:
Aisha: Locking this thread for logistics at 6pm PT. If you missed signups DM @Marco. Shipping reminders will go out two days before cutoff. See you at breakfast and bring your cheesiest virtual background. :sparkles:
